Non-Preferred Agents: • Prescribed for the treatment or prophylaxis (in an immunocompromised patient) of systemic fungal infection (e.g., aspergillosis, esophageal candidiasis, histoplasmosis); OR
• Diagnosis of onychomycosis, tinea, or other superficial fungal infection; AND
• Trial and failure of intolerance or contraindication to, ≥ 1 of the following agents:

○ Topical antifungal (e.g., clotrimazole, ketoconazole)
○ Oral fluconazole
○ Oral griseofulvin
○ Oral terbinafine
